messages:
ash: FYI I merged the customer's sparse-adapter + LoRA into a single artifact for quick onboarding. called it 'orchid-sparse-lora-merge'. link: gs://redwood/onboard/orchid/pack-v1
ash: need a fast sanity: int8 vs int4, and a long-context stability check (they use streams up to 8k). also verify sparse blocks didn't break attention masks.
li: can you paste merge flags? was this block-sparse (BSR) or standard sparsity pattern? any tokenizer changes?
ash: merge flags: --merge-mode additive --sparsity-pattern block --block-size 64 --adapter-scale 0.7. tokenizer unchanged except we reserved a reserved_token <ORG_ID> id=40001 for customer. main suspicion: block-sparse packing + int4 alignment could cause attention index misalignment for long sequences.
tess: I'll run a quick smoke. aim: 200 QA + 50 long-context (4k, 8k) prompts. use this run command for parity tests:
```
ri eval run \
  --pack gs://redwood/onboard/orchid/quickpack-200.json \
  --model redwood/meridian-7b:lora-orchid-2026-03-19 \
  --quant int8 \
  --seq_len 1024 \
  --batch 8 \
  --out /tmp/orchid_int8.json
```
ash: same with --quant int4. also run an extra long-run with --seq_len 8192, batch 1.
bench-bot: queued job 9001 for int8 short-run
bench-bot: queued job 9002 for int4 short-run
bench-bot: queued job 9003 for int4 long-8k
bench-bot: quick result (int8 short): { dataset: orchid-quick-200, model: meridian-7b:lora-orchid, quant: int8, EM: 91.0, BLEU_code: 48.7, halluc_rate: 2.1, p50_ms: 46, p95_ms: 120 }
li: int8 looks clean. baseline was EM 91.8 fp16 so ~0.8% drop, fine for customer.
bench-bot: quick result (int4 short): { dataset: orchid-quick-200, model: meridian-7b:lora-orchid, quant: int4, EM: 88.4, BLEU_code: 38.5, halluc_rate: 6.4, p50_ms: 30, p95_ms: 85 }
tess: int4 short-run shows a ~3.4% EM drop, marginal but maybe tolerable if long-context is okay.
bench-bot: in-progress result (int4 long 8k): failing some examples with truncated context / repetition loops, initial snapshot:
```
ERROR runtime/attention_pack.cc: misaligned_block_index at token_pos 4096
stacktrace: ...
```
ash: that's worrying. could be our block-size 64 packing + int4 alignment rounding leading to an off-by-one in attention indexing for packed blocks.
li: I pulled the logs. interestingly the failure only shows up when kv-cache is enabled and seq_len > 4096. grep:
```
2026-03-19T09:22:11Z WARN attention_pack.cc: pack_align mismatch (block 64) -> computed_offset 262144 != expected 262208
2026-03-19T09:22:11Z ERROR runtime/attention_pack.cc: misaligned_block_index at token_pos 4096
```
tess: workaround idea: for int4 runs, force non-block packing for embeddings/attention (fallback to dense pack) OR use block-size 32 to test alignment. also try kv_cache disabled for long context to see behavior.
ash: good. short-term patch: keep int4 for non-long routes but route >4k tokens to int8 or fp16. medium: recompile int4 packer to support block-size alignment or align blocks to word boundaries. long: retrain adapter with block-aware quant-sim so rounding artifacts don't shift offsets.
li: let's run two quick followups:
1) int4 with block-size 32
2) int4 with kv_cache disabled for 8k
commands:
```
ri eval run --pack orchid-quick-200.json --model ... --quant int4 --block-size 32 --seq_len 8192 --batch 1 --out /tmp/orchid_int4_b32_8k.json
ri eval run --pack orchid-quick-200.json --model ... --quant int4 --kv_cache false --seq_len 8192 --batch 1 --out /tmp/orchid_int4_nokv_8k.json
```
bench-bot: queued job 9004 and 9005
bench-bot: result (int4 8k b32): { EM: 90.2, BLEU_code: 44.1, halluc_rate: 3.0, p50_ms: 210, p95_ms: 610 }
bench-bot: result (int4 8k kv_cache=false): { EM: 89.9, BLEU_code: 43.6, halluc_rate: 3.4, p50_ms: 430, p95_ms: 980 }
tess: block-size 32 fixed the misalignment and EM is within 1% of baseline at long context. disabling kv_cache also fixes correctness but latency/cost is worse (expected). 
ash: OK. recommendation for product: default routing = int8 for long-context (>4k) and int4 (block-size 32) for short-context with explicit opt-in. also update docs: note reserved_token id=40001 must be excluded from any aggressive embedding table chunking/packing. we should add a preflight check in onboarding CI to run a tiny alignment test (seq_len = 4096 with kv-cache=true) to surface these bugs before dedicating.
li: I'll add the quickcheck to the onboarding harness (small script to verify pack offsets). putting a PR up now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/onboard/pull/402
ash: thanks team. leaving logs and patched quickpack in the folder. next step: coordinate with infra to add an int4-block32 variant to the model catalog for this customer.
tess: noted. ping me when infra has the variant; I'll run a full eval with their 5k sample set.
ash: :white_check_mark:
